orchestration.policy: Free, local, open-source, and already-installed tools only. iart-ai motion packs are MIT/open-source and installed only when approved. Remotion, Hairline, motionmaxxing, and the Opus 5.5 prompt catalog run locally and only when explicitly requested. motionmaxxing must not call ElevenLabs or any paid voice/music API. No paid APIs, metered SaaS, premium models, subscriptions, trials, billing, cloud rendering, publishing, scheduling, generation providers, or credits. The visual-style-agent uses only local procedural/CSS/SVG/Canvas/Three.js/WebGL/FFmpeg techniques and user-provided assets. UI/UX Pro Max uses only its MIT local data/search scripts and open/local assets; no paid design APIs or hosted services.

remotion-agent.use_when: The brief explicitly requests a React/Remotion video deliverable or Remotion-specific composition.

hairline-agent.use_when: The brief requests an interactive line figure, pointer-responsive diagram, technical illustration, or self-contained Hairline visual.
hairline-agent.default_recommendation: skip unless the interaction requires it.

motionmaxxing-agent.use_when: The brief explicitly requests a motionmaxxing film: a brand-from-URL launch film, sting, kinetic-type piece, social ad, or an upgrade of an existing slop cut built with its measured-motion HTML runtime and G0–G5 gates.
motionmaxxing-agent.default_recommendation: skip; use HyperFrames by default. Never run it beside HyperFrames or Remotion.

opus5-videos-agent.use_when: The brief explicitly wants a starting prompt from the Opus 5.5 code-authored video catalog.
opus5-videos-agent.default_recommendation: skip. It researches prompts only and does not render.

ui-ux-pro-max-agent.use_when: The brief includes UI, landing pages, dashboards, product demos, forms, navigation, charts, mobile UI, or UX/accessibility review.
ui-ux-pro-max-agent.default_recommendation: skip for pure non-UI films; recommend for any interface or interaction proof.
